prompt: Species: deep-sea whale-fall dweller. Long flowing hair, deep teal fading to near-black at the ends, scattered with tiny glowing cyan dots like lanternfish photophores. Hair ornaments made of crimson tube-worm plumes. Skin pale bone-white with a faint mother-of-pearl iridescent sheen. Eyes: large, black sclera with a thin glowing cyan ring iris, slightly droopy gentle shape. Faint pearly scale patches on cheekbones and collarbones. Wears a high-collared dark navy diving-dress, with an external ivory bone exoskeleton shaped like a small whale ribcage wrapped around her waist as a corset. Barefoot, toes slightly webbed. Calm, soft, melancholic smile. Deep-ocean blue background with drifting marine snow.

Species: void-born organism that eats starlight and radiation. Long white hair with prismatic rainbow edges, floating weightlessly around her as if in zero gravity. Skin is deep indigo and semi-translucent, with a starfield and faint nebula glowing inside her body like a window into space, especially on her arms and legs. Eyes: like a solar eclipse, black iris with a bright golden corona ring, sharp upturned shape. Small crescent-shaped dark marks under her eyes. Wears a torn, oversized vintage white spacesuit jacket, unzipped over a fitted black bodysuit, with an old mission patch. A faint gravitational halo ring behind her head. Curious, mischievous expression. Dark space background with distant stars.

Species: underground slime-mold colony intelligence. Long hair made of branching honey-yellow translucent strands that look like slime mold veins, with pulsing amber nodes, spreading like a network onto the ground around her feet. Skin warm olive with a faint fine net-like vein pattern. Eyes: amber-gold, the pupils are tiny branching network shapes, round and curious. Faint yellow freckle-like spore dots on her nose. Wears a dusty explorer's cave outfit: brown oilskin poncho, cargo shorts, tall boots, a lantern-shaped hair clip. Holding a mushroom gently. Bright, cheerful, puzzle-loving expression. Cave background with glowing fungi.

Species: lab-grown bio-weapon girl from an abandoned culture vat. Short messy wet hair, pale mint green with a darker teal under-layer, droplets still dripping. Heterochromia: left eye pale pink, right eye gold, both with vertical slit pupils. Dark tired under-eye circles. Skin is a patchwork of slightly different skin tones joined by neat glowing turquoise suture seams, like grafted tissue. A barcode and the number 07 marked on the side of her neck. Small medical IV ports on her forearms with short cables. Wears an oversized white lab coat over a pale blue hospital gown, ID wristband, bare feet. Shy, wary expression clutching the coat sleeve. Background: dim laboratory with a cracked cylindrical glass culture tank.

Species: abyssal entity that devours knowledge by looking. Very long straight jet-black hair with deep violet sheen, and within the hair there are many small open eyes with violet irises, some blinking. A floating halo made of a ring of closed eyes above her head. Main eyes: large violet with star-shaped pupils, heavy-lidded sleepy look, with dark under-eye circles. Skin porcelain pale. Thin black vein-like markings creeping from her fingertips up to the wrists. Wears an elegant black and dark purple gothic librarian dress with a high collar, a long ribbon tie, holding an old book with an eye on its cover. Soft, sleepy, slightly unsettling smile. Background: dark endless library fading into void.

Species: volcanic vent organism that eats metal and minerals. Long wavy hair like flowing lava: bright orange and red at the roots, cooling into black glassy obsidian at the tips with glowing cracks. Skin is warm dark brown with glowing magma-orange crack lines on her arms, legs, and one cheek. Eyes: molten gold, bright and energetic, with a thin black ring. Her forearms and shins are covered in metallic plates of steel and silver that look grown from her skin, absorbed from eaten metal. Wears a sturdy heat-resistant blacksmith outfit: a short charred leather apron, rolled sleeves, goggles pushed up on her head. Biting a steel bar playfully. Confident grinning expression showing a small sharp fang. Background: volcanic forge with drifting embers.

Species: ancient extremophile revived from permafrost, inspired by tardigrades. Fluffy medium-length frost-white hair with small ice crystals and a pale sky-blue gradient at the tips. Skin pale icy blue-white. Eyes: pale blue with multiple concentric rings in the iris like ice layers, sleepy half-closed. Faint frost-pattern markings on her cheeks. Wears a huge puffy segmented winter coat in cream and pale blue that resembles a tardigrade's chubby body, with eight small stubby toggles, mittens, fur-lined hood with small round ear-like bumps. Breath visible as frost. Sleepy, cozy, slightly dazed expression. Background: snowy tundra with a broken block of ancient ice behind her.

Species: carnivorous pitcher-plant girl who lures prey with a sweet scent. Long hair in a gradient from fresh leaf green at the roots to deep wine red at the tips, decorated with small pitcher-plant shaped ornaments with lids. Skin soft peach with faint green leaf-vein patterns on her shoulders. Eyes: bright pink with flower-shaped pupils, warm and inviting, long eyelashes. Small glossy nectar droplets on her fingertips. Wears an elegant botanical dress with a skirt shaped like a pitcher plant, green with red veins and a frilled rim, vine sleeves, flower collar. Holding a watering can. Sweet, gentle smile with a slightly dangerous gleam. Background: misty tropical greenhouse.

Species: nanite organism that hunts and eats mechanoid robots. Medium-length silver hair with glowing red circuit-trace lines running through it, asymmetrical cut. Eyes: red with LED-like ring pupils, sharp and cool. Thin red circuit patterns under her eyes like tear lines. Skin pale gray. Her right arm is assimilated machine parts: dark metal plates, exposed cables, and a cannon barrel taken from a robot, merging seamlessly into organic skin at the shoulder with a silver liquid-metal boundary. Wears a black tactical jacket, gray scarf, combat boots, scavenged robot armor pieces as accessories. Stoic, cool expression. Background: wasteland with a broken robot wreck.

Species: mirror mimic that copies the forms of what it eats. Long hair divided into distinct colored sections: platinum, chestnut brown, black, and pink, each like a different person's hair. Mismatched eyes: one blue, one green, both with a faint mirror-like silver shine. Skin like fine white porcelain, with thin cracks that reveal reflective mirror shards underneath, on her left cheek, neck and hands. Wears a cute patchwork dress assembled from different people's clothing styles: a school-uniform collar, a farmer's apron, a noble's lace sleeve, a soldier's belt. Holding a hand mirror that reflects a featureless silhouette. Gentle, slightly lonely smile. Background: room of broken mirrors.

Species: moth-like species that evolves through metamorphosis in a cocoon. Fluffy shoulder-length pale lilac and cream hair, with two feathery moth antennae on her head. A big soft white fur collar around her neck like a moth's fluffy thorax. Eyes: large, dark plum with starry glints, round and gentle. Large folded pale green and lilac moth wings on her back with eye-spot patterns. Skin fair. Wears a soft layered nightgown-like dress in moonlight colors with silk cocoon threads trailing from her sleeves. Holding a small lantern, attracted to its light. Shy, dreamy expression. Background: moonlit night forest with a large silk cocoon hanging from a branch.

Species: salt-flat organism related to halophilic archaea, drains moisture from prey and grows salt crystals. Long straight hair in rose-pink with crystalline translucent tips like pink salt crystals. Skin pale with clusters of pink and white salt crystals growing on her shoulders, elbows, and knees. Eyes: pale pink-white with cube-shaped crystal pupils, cool and calm. Faint pink salt-crust markings around her eyes. Wears a light flowing desert outfit: white hooded cloak, pink sash, layered sheer fabrics, sandals. Holding a parasol. Serene, aloof expression. Background: vast pink salt lake under a bright sky with reflections.
